page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no margin notes. Running head at the top, then the page number at the top left, then the chapter heading "CAP. V.", its italic title, the running text, and the catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: The initial Q is a large woodcut-style letter and is joined to "Uantum". The word "Ignavia" carries a grave accent on the final a in print, which I could not read with certainty. "reddunturn" is a transcription error on my part and should read "reduntur" as printed; the word is "reduntur" with the d broken at the line end. The line "Scilicet hominum mentes" is the start of a paragraph that continues on the next page; the catchword "otio" is not included in the text. Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
